plain: A man named Kiran Ilum Xenov told podcast host Jesse Michels that in September 1997 he was aboard an alien spacecraft. He says the beings there told him they come from other dimensions, that they created humans, and that this was humanity's only real achievement. According to him they also said humanity is not ready, which, if true, would recast where people come from.
